001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
008import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
009
010/**
011 * {@code x + y ≠ z}
012 *
013 * @author jimmy
014 */
015public class PropNotEqualXY_Z extends Propagator<IntVar> {
016
017    private final IntVar x, y, z;
018
019    @SuppressWarnings({"unchecked"})
020    public PropNotEqualXY_Z(IntVar x, IntVar y, IntVar z) {
021        super(new IntVar[]{x, y, z}, PropagatorPriority.BINARY, false);
022        this.x = x;
023        this.y = y;
024        this.z = z;
025    }
026
027    @Override
028    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
029        return IntEventType.all();
030    }
031
032    private boolean supportForX(int x) {
033        if (z.getDomainSize() > 1) {
034            return true;
035        }
036        int yub = y.getUB();
037        // todo iterate over whichever var has smaller domain
038        for (int i = y.getLB(); i <= yub; i = y.nextValue(i)) {
039            if (!z.contains(x + i)) {
040                return true;
041            }
042        }
043        return false;
044    }
045
046    private boolean supportForY(int y) {
047        if (z.getDomainSize() > 1) {
048            return true;
049        }
050        int xub = x.getUB();
051        for (int i = x.getLB(); i <= xub; i = x.nextValue(i)) {
052            if (!z.contains(y + i)) {
053                return true;
054            }
055        }
056        return false;
057    }
058
059    private boolean supportForZ(int z) {
060        if (x.getDomainSize() > 1 || y.getDomainSize() > 1) {
061            return true;
062        }
063        int xub = x.getUB();
064        for (int i = x.getLB(); i <= xub; i = x.nextValue(i)) {
065            if (!y.contains(z - i)) {
066                return true;
067            }
068        }
069        return false;
070    }
071
072    @Override
073    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
074        boolean changed;
075        do {
076            changed = false;
077            int xub = x.getUB();
078            for (int i = x.getLB(); i <= xub; i = x.nextValue(i)) {
079                if (!supportForX(i)) {
080                    x.removeValue(i, this);
081                }
082            }
083            int yub = y.getUB();
084            for (int i = y.getLB(); i <= yub; i = y.nextValue(i)) {
085                if (!supportForY(i)) {
086                    changed |= y.removeValue(i, this);
087                }
088            }
089            int zub = z.getUB();
090            for (int i = z.getLB(); i <= zub; i = z.nextValue(i)) {
091                if (!supportForZ(i)) {
092                    changed |= z.removeValue(i, this);
093                }
094            }
095        } while (changed);
096    }
097
098    @Override
099    public ESat isEntailed() {
100        int xub = x.getUB();
101        for (int i = x.getLB(); i <= xub; i = x.nextValue(i)) {
102            if (supportForX(i)) {
103                return x.isInstantiated() && y.isInstantiated() && z.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
104            }
105        }
106        return ESat.FALSE;
107    }
108
109    @Override
110    public String toString() {
111        return x + " + " + y + " != " + z;
112    }
113}
